titleEn: Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction

articles.en:
The Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 2: The Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction shall have the competence to lead and manage the land management, urban planning and construction sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction shall be led by one Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
This Law is declared to be urgent.
